description: Three-way conformational comparison of CBG states, per structural element
code:
import numpy as np, requests, os, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs('/tmp/cbg',exist_ok=True)
for p in ['2VDY','2VDX','4C49','4C41','4BB2','2V95']:
    open(f'/tmp/cbg/{p}.pdb','w').write(requests.get(f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb',timeout=60).text)
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
up=lambda a:''.join(requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
HUm,RAm=up('P08185')[22:],up('P31211')[22:]
def nw(s1,s2,gap=-8,ext=-0.8):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    F[0,1:]=gap+ext*np.arange(m);F[1:,0]=gap+ext*np.arange(n);P[0,1:]=2;P[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            o=(F[i-1,j-1]+(3 if s1[i-1]==s2[j-1] else -1),F[i-1,j]+gap,F[i,j-1]+gap)
            k=int(np.argmax(o));F[i,j]=o[k];P[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;a=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i>0 and j>0 and P[i,j]==0: a.append((i,j));i-=1;j-=1
        elif i>0 and (j==0 or P[i,j]==1): i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return a[::-1]
h2r=dict(nw(HUm,RAm))
def ca(pid,ch):
    d={}
    for l in open(f'/tmp/cbg/{pid}.pdb'):
        if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA' and l[21]==ch and l[16] in (' ','A') and l[17:20] in AA3:
            d[int(l[22:26])]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    return d
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]);R=Vt.T@D@U.T;return R,qc-R@pc
def prof(dA,dB):
    keys=sorted(set(dA)&set(dB)); sel=list(keys)
    for _ in range(8):
        P=np.array([dA[k] for k in sel]);Q=np.array([dB[k] for k in sel]);R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
        d=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1);cut=max(1.5,np.percentile(d,75))
        new=[k for k,x in zip(sel,d) if x<=cut]
        if len(new)<80 or len(new)==len(sel): break
        sel=new
    P=np.array([dA[k] for k in keys]);Q=np.array([dB[k] for k in keys])
    return pd.DataFrame({'h':keys,'dev':np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1)}),len(sel)
rat=ca('2V95','A')
ratH={h:rat[r] for h,r in h2r.items() if r in rat}
P1,n1=prof(ratH, ca('2VDY','A'))     # native rat vs cleaved human + cortisol
P2,n2=prof(ca('2VDX','A'), ca('2VDY','A'))   # cleaved apo vs cleaved + cortisol (same species)
P3,n3=prof(ratH, ca('2VDX','A'))     # native rat vs cleaved apo human
REG={'helix A (16-36)':(16,36),'helix B (44-57)':(44,57),'helix C (60-71)':(60,71),
 'helix D (79-96)':(79,96),'hD connecting loop (97-117)':(97,117),'helix E (118-130)':(118,130),
 'helix F (140-156)':(140,156),'s4B/s3B steroid wall (230-270)':(230,270),
 'hI + s5A (290-320)':(290,320),'C-term s1C/s4B (360-383)':(360,383)}
rows=[]
for k,(lo,hi) in REG.items():
    r={'region':k}
    for lbl,P in [('ratNative_vs_humCleavedCort',P1),('humCleavedApo_vs_humCleavedCort',P2),('ratNative_vs_humCleavedApo',P3)]:
        s=P[(P.h>=lo)&(P.h<=hi)]['dev']; r[lbl]=round(s.mean(),2) if len(s) else np.nan
    rows.append(r)
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print('=== Mean CA deviation (A) per structural element ===')
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
print(f'\ncores: P1 n={n1}, P2 n={n2}, P3 n={n3}')
print('\nresidues of interest, P2 (apo vs cortisol-bound cleaved human CBG, identical numbering):')
print(P2[P2.h.isin([18,19,22,89,93,100,105,110,232,260,264,371])].round(2).to_string(index=False))
print('\nmax deviation in hD connecting loop 97-117, P2:', P2[(P2.h>=97)&(P2.h<=117)].nlargest(5,'dev').round(2).to_string(index=False))
tab.to_csv('/tmp/cbg/region_dev_3way.csv',index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7),sharex=True)
for ax,(P,ti) in zip(axes,[(P1,'Native rat CBG (2V95) vs cleaved human CBG + cortisol (2VDY)'),
                           (P2,'Cleaved human CBG apo (2VDX) vs cleaved human CBG + cortisol (2VDY)')]):
    ax.plot(P.h,P.dev,lw=1.1,color='#333')
    for (lo,hi),c,lab in [((79,96),'#d95f02','helix D'),((97,117),'#1b9e77','hD connecting loop'),
                          ((340,358),'#7570b3','reactive centre loop')]:
        ax.axvspan(lo,hi,color=c,alpha=.25,label=lab)
    for r,m in [(89,'H89'),(93,'L93')]:
        s=P[P.h==r]
        if len(s):
            y=s.dev.iloc[0];ax.plot([r],[y],'o',color='crimson',zorder=5)
            ax.annotate(m,(r,y),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(4,6),color='crimson',fontsize=9)
    ax.set_yscale('log');ax.set_ylabel('CA deviation (A)');ax.set_title(ti,fontsize=10);ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper left')
axes[1].set_xlabel('human CBG mature residue number (UniProt P08185 position minus 22)')
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
